answer: Make reputation convex and non-transferable: each identity voting weight is the square of its independently graded work history, while endorsements must cross a non-kin graph cut. Splitting one history across ten clones turns R^2 into 10(R/10)^2, losing 90% of influence; a farm must therefore buy ten separate streams of original work and outside attestations. An oasis account cannot simply bridge to its own ridge of clones, because same-cluster edges are discounted.
